style_when: the story turns on one physical thing — a part, a material, a component, a document — and what that thing costs, contains or crosses a border is the news
prompt: Extreme close-up macro photograph of a heavy, machined steel industrial gear resting on a dusty warehouse shelf. 100mm macro lens, one razor-sharp focal plane with a shallow depth of field. Visible surface texture, machining marks, and accumulated dust. Soft directional daylight filtering through industrial skylights, catching the metallic edges. The hero object is placed off-centre on the thirds, with the blurred expanse of warehouse racking falling away into deep shadow in the background. Editorial elegance, moody cinematic lighting, sophisticated color palette.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, logos, bare geometry, empty white background, people, abstract shapes
rationale: An extreme close-up of a heavy, physical spare part emphasizes the tangible burden of storage and depreciation, contrasting sharply with the abstract financial concept of a loan rate.
subject: heavy industrial steel gear resting on a dusty warehouse shelf
alt_text: Heavy machined steel industrial gear resting on a dusty warehouse shelf in extreme close-up.
caption: When storage, handling, and risk are properly priced, the physical burden of slow-moving items quickly flips from profitable to negative.
